text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Bubble. Regarding your birthday present— 
first of all, you have my thanks.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Still, what was that? The moment I opened 
the drawer, a party popper exploded... 
When did you even set that up?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Just yesterday! Though I did start 
preparing quite a while ago.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Pretty impressive setup, wasn't it? I just 
wanted to make a strong impression and be 
the very first to give you a present.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it was definitely worth getting Fuji 
and Fine to help out.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*... Your initiative is certainly a 
virtue, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We can't have this kind of uproar every 
time we celebrate a Ritto dorm resident! 
At this rate, the dorm's public morals 
will be—!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
No, no, going that far is really just for 
today, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
You of all people are the one I never 
wanted to think of me as "just one of the 
crowd" —Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
“—No matter how your present is handed to 
you, don't let it surprise you, alright?”
